item.text: The error is reclassified in `authenticate`: it replaces every `setupContext` failure with `AccessDenied`. The existing test also expects access denial for the unknown cluster and missing tunnel cases, so I’m correcting those expectations first to confirm the failure.

Root cause evidence: "'`Forwarder.authenticate` (forwarder.go) unconditionally replaces every `setupContext` error with `trace.AccessDenied`. `setupContext` preserves `trace.BadParameter` for missing reverse tunnel; `kubeutils.CheckOrSetKubeCluster` returns `BadParameter` for an unknown explicit Kubernetes cluster. Hypothesis: preserving `setupContext` errors with `trace.Wrap(err)` will retain their trace classification while keeping access-related errors classified as access denied.

}

item.text:
Updated `authenticate` to wrap `setupContext` errors, preserving their trace classification. Authorization failures and unsupported user types remain `AccessDenied`; unknown Kubernetes clusters and missing reverse tunnels do not. I also added the specified `httplib` error-writer wrappers.

Both relevant package test suites passed with `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/httplib ./lib/kube/proxy -count=1`.
